access.membersLocal: Group membership is read from Entra ID. In local mode the demo users define who has access.
access.howItWorksBody: Keigan does not keep its own user list. At every sign-in it reads the person's Entra ID group memberships: members of the admin group can change this application, members of the reader group can view it. Create both groups in SailPoint with the names below and add people there; nobody needs to be added in Keigan.
